How it works

01

Save from anywhere

Tap the three dots in any app, then Allim. Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit, X — anything with a share sheet. It saves and gets out of the way in under half a second.

02

Bring the backlog

Everything you have ever sent yourself, saved, or liked on Instagram, imported in one pass. Allim reads the file Instagram gives you. It never signs in to your account.

03

Sorted for you

It groups what you save by who made it, so twelve reels from one account become a place rather than twelve scattered links. No folders to keep tidy.

The numbers

Saving something is one thing. Knowing why it worked is another.

Raw counts cannot be compared across videos — a two-million-view post and a forty-thousand-view post are not the same kind of thing. Rates can. Allim stores the counts and shows you the rates.

Full numbers on YouTube. Best-effort on TikTok. Instagram, Pinterest and X publish nothing to anyone who is not logged in, so Allim shows no numbers there rather than inventing them.
